The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1952–1953''' was contested by 56 teams participating in four divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of each division of the [[Netherlands]]. [[RCH (football club)|RCH]] won this year's championship by beating [[FC Eindhoven]], [[Sparta Rotterdam]] and [[Vitesse Arnhem]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse A:'''
*Moving in from other divisions: [[AFC Ajax]], [[VV DOS|DOS]], [[NEC Nijmegen]], [[RCH (football club)|RCH]], [[VV Sneek Wit Zwart|Sneek Wit Zwart]], [[Telstar (football club)|VSV]], [[FC Wageningen]] and [[FC Zwolle|Zwolsche Boys]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Heracles Almelo|Heracles]]
'''Eerste Klasse B:'''
*Moving in from other divisions: [[AGOVV Apeldoorn]], [[AFC DWS|DWS]], [[USV Elinkwijk|Elinkwijk]], [[Go Ahead Eagles|Go Ahead]], [[HVV 't Gooi]], [[HFC Haarlem]] and [[sc Heerenveen]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Telstar (football club)|Stormvogels]]
'''Eerste Klasse C:'''
*Moving in from other divisions: [[RKVV Brabantia|Brabantia]], [[Emma (football club)|Emma]], [[HBS Craeyenhout]], [[LONGA (football club)|LONGA]], [[Sparta Rotterdam]], [[Theole]] and [[VVV Venlo]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[SBV Excelsior]]
'''Eerste Klasse D:'''
*Moving in from other divisions: [[ADO Den Haag]], [[Roda JC|Bleijerheide]], [[DHC Delft]], [[FC Eindhoven]], [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]], [[NAC Breda|NAC]] and [[RBC Roosendaal]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[TEC Tiel]]
